chapters.desc: The heart of the Scarlet Monastery: the Chapel Gardens and the Crusader's Chapel, held by Scarlet Commander Mograine and High Inquisitor Whitemane. The door is locked: you need The Scarlet Key from the Library.

chapters.title: Razorfen Downs
chapters.desc: The ancient burial grounds of the quilboar, now held by the Scourge. Amnennar the Coldbringer leads the undead from the top of the Downs.

chapters.title: Uldaman
chapters.desc: An ancient titan vault buried beneath the Badlands, overrun by troggs and Shadowforge dwarves. Archaedas guards the Discs of Norgannon in its deepest chamber.

chapters.title: Riverglades
chapters.why: Forever's new zone: a pirate shore with several straight kill quests, and the Krol'dok Stronghold dungeon next door.
chapters.tip: Questie doesn't know these quests yet, so the giver spots come from NPC positions. Check Wowhead (the quest name links there) if one isn't where it says.

chapters.title: Krol'dok Stronghold
chapters.desc: Ogre outrunners have been kidnapping travelers and raiding settlements across the Riverglades. Their trail leads to a fortress of workshops, encampments and guarded inner passages, where strange chanting is heard after nightfall.

chapters.why: Two Gordunni ogre kill quests and the Northspring harpies, all from Camp Mojache.
chapters.tip: Talo Thornhoof also hands out "The Strength of Corruption" (Felwood bears and wolves). Take it at 47 and carry it.
skip: War on the Woodpaw and Alpha Strike (manes drop)

chapters.title: Zul'Farrak
chapters.desc: The sun-baked troll city in the deserts of Tanaris, home of the Sandfury tribe and their chief, Ukorz Sandscalp.

chapters.tip: Take the two long ones too: Message to the Wildhammer and the Guard Captain job are slow, but the mobs are where you are going anyway.

chapters.why: Deadwood furbolgs, the Jaedenar cult and the owlbeast chain are all straight kills.
chapters.tip: Timbermaw Ally starts the Timbermaw reputation chain that carries you into Winterspring.

chapters.desc: Long rumored to hold high-ranking prisoners, including King Varian Wrynn, the prison on Alcaz Island has been out of reach until now. Inside, the Defias Brotherhood and the naga are at war.

chapters.title: Sunken Temple
chapters.desc: The Temple of Atal'Hakkar, sunk beneath the Pool of Tears in the Swamp of Sorrows. The Atal'ai trolls try to summon their blood god Hakkar here, while the green dragons of Eranikus guard the lower halls.
tips: Warrior: do the warrior chain before you go. Any Horde warrior trainer gives A Troubled Spirit, which sends you to the Fallen Hero of the Horde at the Blasted Lands entrance. His two kill quests (Helboar, then Shadowsworn) count the paladin's kills too, so do them together. Voodoo Feathers is then done inside: the six troll guardians on the balconies drop the feathers.
Paladin: Forever has no Horde paladin quest here. The paladin's Sunken Temple quest, Forging the Mightstone, is Alliance only.
Both of you: Jammal'an the Prophet and The God Hakkar are the big ones. The troll guardians you kill for Jammal'an are the same ones that drop the warrior's feathers.
Sunken Temple is a five-player dungeon. A warrior tank and a paladin healer make a good core; fill three damage dealers.

chapters.title: Burning Steppes
chapters.why: Not many Horde kill quests, but Flame Crest is where you pick up the Blackrock dungeon quests.
chapters.tip: Do this right before Blackrock Depths and Lower Blackrock Spire.

chapters.title: Blackrock Depths
chapters.desc: The capital of the Dark Iron dwarves beneath Blackrock Mountain: the Detention Block, the Ring of Law, the Grim Guzzler and Shadowforge City, ruled by Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.

chapters.title: Western Plaguelands
chapters.why: Andorhal and the Scarlet camps give a tidy loop of kill and one-click quests.
chapters.tip: Chromie's chain in Andorhal later leads into Eastern Plaguelands' Darrowshire story.

chapters.tip: Light's Hope Chapel is the flight point and where the Stratholme and Scholomance quests start.

chapters.tip: Storm Shadowhoof's first two hunts are single named beasts and the kill counts for both of you. The third (Shy-Rotam) needs dropped meat, so it is left out.

chapters.why: Forever's new zone has a lot of kill and quick quests. The quest databases don't have its quest givers or chain order yet, so this chapter is a checklist, not a route.
chapters.tip: Several other zones send you here with breadcrumbs (A Cousin Abroad, The Grand Alliance, The Source of the Corruption). Take them on the way.

chapters.title: Silithus
chapters.why: A short two-step dredge kill chain and the Twilight Geolords at 60.
chapters.tip: Most Silithus quests are drop-heavy or feed the Ahn'Qiraj war effort; only the kill quests are listed.

chapters.title: Lower Blackrock Spire
chapters.desc: The lower halls of Blackrock Spire, held by the Spirestone, Smolderthorn and Bloodaxe clans of the Dark Horde under Overlord Wyrmthalak.

chapters.title: Dire Maul: East
chapters.desc: The eastern quarter of the ruined Highborne city of Eldre'Thalas, overgrown by the Warpwood and ruled by the satyr Alzzin the Wildshaper. Pusillin carries the Crescent Key that opens the other wings.

chapters.title: Blackmaw Hold
chapters.desc: Beyond a long-sealed gate in Azshara lies the furbolg city of the Blackmaw clan, fighting a corruption that spreads through its groves and mountain tunnels. A large max-level dungeon with several routes and bosses; its depths may lead even farther below Azeroth.

chapters.title: Dire Maul: West
chapters.desc: The Capital Gardens and the Court of the Highborne, where the last Shen'dralar keep the demon Immol'thar imprisoned behind five pylons. Needs the Crescent Key from Pusillin.

chapters.title: Dire Maul: North
chapters.desc: Gordok Commons, the ogre-held northern wing. Kill King Gordok to become the new king; leave the guards alive (the Tribute Run) for a bigger tribute chest.

chapters.title: Upper Blackrock Spire
chapters.desc: The top of Blackrock Spire, held by Rend Blackhand's Dark Horde and General Drakkisath's black dragonflight. The door needs the Seal of Ascension.

chapters.title: Stratholme: Living
chapters.desc: The main gate of Stratholme: the burning streets, the Scarlet Bastion and the Hall of Lights, where Grand Crusader Dathrohan reveals himself as the dreadlord Balnazzar.

chapters.title: Stratholme: Undead
chapters.desc: The service entrance side of Stratholme, held by the Scourge: the three ziggurats, the Slaughter House and Baron Rivendare's stronghold. Kill the Baron within 45 minutes to save Ysida Harmon.

chapters.title: Scholomance
chapters.desc: The Barov family crypt on Caer Darrow, turned into the Cult of the Damned's school of necromancy. Darkmaster Gandling rules the halls; the Skeleton Key from the Barov quests opens the doors.

chapters.title: Shaper's Terrace
chapters.desc: An ancient titan facility in the northern hills of Un'Goro Crater, overlooking dinosaurs, tar pits and powerful crystals. Collect power crystals across Un'Goro and use them at the consoles inside the terrace.

4024.obj: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay Bael'Gar. Use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on Bael'Gar's remains to capture the Fiery Essence. Return the Encased Fiery Essence to Cyrus Therepentous.
4024.note: Show Cyrus a Black Dragonflight Molt first (A Taste of Flame, or kill the drake he summons). Then kill Bael'Gar and use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on his remains to collect the Encased Fiery Essence.

4061.obj: Venture to the Burning Steppes and recover 10 Fractured Elemental Shards for Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania. You recall Theodora mentioning the golems and elementals of that region as being a source for these shards.

4063.obj: Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach.
4063.note: Kill Golem Lord Argelmach for his head and collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the constructs guarding him.

4083.obj: Bring Gloom'rel 2 Star Rubies, 20 Gold Bars and 10 Truesilver Bars, then place them in the Spectral Chalice in the Summoners' Tomb.
4083.note: Mining 230. Talk to Gloom'rel before the Seven fight; give the Spectral Chalice 2 Star Rubies, 20 Gold Bars and 10 Truesilver Bars to learn Smelt Dark Iron.

4120.obj: Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas wants you to kill 12 Angerclaw Grizzlies and 12 Felpaw Ravagers in Felwood.

4123.obj: Bring the Heart of the Mountain to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.
4123.note: The Heart of the Mountain is in the vault safe after the Dark Keepers.

4132.obj: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay General Angerforge! Return to Warlord Goretooth when the task is complete.
4132.note: Needs both KILL ON SIGHT quests and the Grark Lorkrub escort first.

pre.n: KILL ON SIGHT: Dark Iron Dwarves
KILL ON SIGHT: High Ranking Dark Iron Officials

4134.obj: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
4134.note:
Break the three kegs in the Grim Guzzler storeroom to spawn Hurley Blackbreath and his guards.

Optional introductory quest:

4136.obj: Bring Ribbly's Head to Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.
4136.pu: Yuka Screwspigot, Flame Crest, Burning Steppes
4136.ti: Yuka Screwspigot, Flame Crest, Burning Steppes

4145.obj: Hunt 5 Bloodpetal Lashers, 5 Bloodpetal Threshers, 5 Bloodpetal Flayers and 5 Bloodpetal Trappers for Larion at Marshal's Refuge.

4146.obj: Deliver the Unloaded Zapper and 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze to Larion in Marshal's Refuge.
4146.note: Atal'ai Haze drops from the temple's worms, lurkers and oozes.

4201.obj: Bring 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara's Filled Vial to Mistress Nagmara in Blackrock Depths.
4201.note: Gromsblood, Giant Silver Veins (Azshara cliff giants) and the vial filled at Golakka Hot Springs in Un'Goro. Opens a peaceful way through the bar on later visits.

4284.obj: Collect 7 Power Crystals of each color: red, blue, yellow, and green. Bring them to J.D. Collie at Marshal's Refuge.

4285.obj: Discover the location of the Northern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.
req: Discover and examine the Northern Crystal Pylon

4287.obj: Discover the location of the Eastern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.
req: Discover and examine the Eastern Crystal Pylon

4288.obj: Discover the location of the Western Crystal Pylon.
req: Discover and examine the Western Crystal Pylon

4290.obj: Find the carcass of Lar'korwi's freshest kill and steal a Piece of Threshadon Carcass before returning to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.
4290.note: One carcass at the edge of the Slithering Scar.

4295.obj: Bring Private Rocknot two Dark Iron Ale Mugs.
4295.pu: Private Rocknot, Grim Guzzler, Blackrock Depths
4295.ti: Private Rocknot, Grim Guzzler, Blackrock Depths
4295.note: Buy Dark Iron Ale Mugs from Plugger Spazzring and keep handing them to Rocknot. The drunken event opens the bar route and can turn Phalanx hostile.

4296.obj: Bring the Tablet Transcript to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.

4449.obj: Kill 8 Dark Iron Geologists and bring 15 pieces of Silk Cloth to the person locked in the outhouse in Searing Gorge.
4449.note: Also needs 15 Silk Cloth each from your bags. The outhouse door is the quest giver.

4491.n: A Little Help From My Friends
4491.obj: Lead Ringo to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge. If Ringo faints, use Spraggle's Canteen to revive him.
req: Escort Ringo to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge

4492.obj: Find Ringo at Fire Plume Ridge.

4501.obj: Kill 10 Pterrordax and 15 Frenzied Pterrordax, then speak to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.
4501.note: Picked up from the sign at Marshal's Refuge.

4505.obj: Collect a sample of corrupted water from the Jadefire Satyrs' moonwell and bring it to Winna Hazzard at Bloodvenom Post.

4506.obj: Take Winna's kitten to the corrupted moon well, release it, then bring it back to Winna. Once you have returned to Winna, click on the cat to release it to Winna.
req: Return the corrupted cat to Winna Hazzard
4506.note: Use the flask on a Felwood saber, then it follows you back to Winna.

4521.obj: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to kill 15 Raging Owlbeasts and 15 Ragged Owlbeasts.

4721.obj: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 10 Berserk Owlbeasts in Winterspring.
4721.note: Third Wild Guardians step; Berserk Owlbeasts are in Winterspring's border cave area.

4724.obj: Slay Halycon, pack mistress of the Bloodaxe worg.
4724.note: Kill Halycon, the worg den mother. Be ready for Gizrul the Slavener, who comes for you right after.

4726.obj: Bring 8 Broodling Essence and the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900 to Tinkee Steamboil at the Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.
4726.note: Use the Draco-Incarcinatrix on a broodling, then kill it; each of you needs 8.

4729.obj: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Bloodaxe Worg Pups. Use the cage to carry the ferocious little beasts. Bring back a Caged Worg Pup to Kibler.
4729.note: Use the supplied cage on a Bloodaxe Worg Pup in the worg area.

4735.obj: Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.
4735.pu: Tinkee Steamboil, Flame Crest, Burning Steppes
4735.ti: Tinkee Steamboil, Flame Crest, Burning Steppes
4735.note: Using the module on the eggs in the Rookery can hatch whelps.

4741.obj: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 13 Moontouched Owlbeasts.

4742.obj: Find the three gemstones of command: the Gemstone of Smolderthorn, Gemstone of Spirestone and Gemstone of Bloodaxe. Return them, along with the Unadorned Seal of Ascension, to Vaelan. The generals are War Master Voone of the Smolderthorn, Highlord Omokk of the Spirestone and Overlord Wyrmthalak of the Bloodaxe.

4743.obj: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. Find the ancient drake Emberstrife and beat him until his will is broken, place the Unforged Seal of Ascension before him, then use the Orb of Draconic Energy on him and force the Flames of the Black Dragonflight upon the Unforged Seal of Ascension.
4743.note: Take the Unforged Seal and the Orb of Draconic Energy to Emberstrife in the Wyrmbog, Dustwallow Marsh. The forged seal opens the UBRS door.

4768.obj: Bring the Darkstone Tablet to Shadow Mage Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
4768.note:
The Darkstone Tablet lies on the ground in the Rookery.

Optional introductory quest:

4771.obj: Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance. Defeat Vectus, then return to Betina Bigglezink.
4771.pu: Betina Bigglezink, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
4771.ti: Betina Bigglezink, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
4771.note: Use Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room and defeat Vectus.

4787.obj: Bring the Ancient Egg to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

4788.obj: Bring the Fifth and Sixth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.
4788.note: The fifth and sixth Mosh'aru tablets are in the Smolderthorn troll area. Continues with Confront Yeh'kinya and The Hand of Rastakhan.

4809.obj: Bring 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns to Felnok Steelspring.

4842.obj: Follow Donova Snowden's instructions, then report back. -

4862.obj: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 15 Spire Spider Eggs for Kibler. By the sound of it, these eggs could be found near spiders.
4862.note: Spire Spider Eggs are in the spider tunnels.

4866.obj: In the heart of Blackrock Spire you will find Mother Smolderweb. Engage her and get her to poison you. Return to Ragged John while poisoned so that he can 'milk' you.
4866.pu: Ragged John, Flame Crest, Burning Steppes
4866.ti: Ragged John, Flame Crest, Burning Steppes
4866.note: Get poisoned by Mother Smolderweb and reach Ragged John while still poisoned. Don't let anyone cleanse it.

4867.obj: Read Warosh's Scroll. Bring Warosh's Mojo to Warosh.
4867.note: Bring Highlord Omokk's Head and a Roughshod Pike to Urok's Tribute Pile beyond the spiders to start the waves.

4903.obj: Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.
4903.note: Talk to Goretooth to receive his Command item and click it to start the quest. The Important Blackrock Documents spawn near the three generals.

4971.obj: Use the Temporal Displacer near one of Andorhal's silos and uncover Temporal Parasites. Slay 15 Temporal Parasites, and then return the Temporal Displacer to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

4972.obj: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches, found in lockboxes amongst the rubble of the city.  Return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.
4972.note: Watches drop from the same Andorhal mobs and lie in crates; each needs 5.

4981.obj: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find out what happened to Bijou.

4982.obj: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. You recall her mentioning that she stashed them on the bottom floor of the city.
4982.note: Then take Bijou's Reconnaissance Report to Lexlort in Kargath for the reward.

4984.obj: Destroy 8 Diseased Wolves, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

4985.obj: Destroy 8 Diseased Grizzlies, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

5047.obj: Talk to Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook.
5047.pu: From The Beast's corpse, Upper Blackrock Spire
5047.note: He appears from The Beast's corpse after the fight. Malyfous then offers the Pristine Hide of the Beast exchanges.

5054.obj: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Ursius.

5055.obj: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Brumeran.

5056.obj: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.

5082.obj: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Pathfinders, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Totemics.

5096.obj: Proceed to the Scarlet Crusade's base camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears and destroy their command tent. Place the Scourge banner at the camp, and then return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
req: Destroy the command tent and plant the Scourge banner in the camp
5096.note: Burn the tent and plant the banner at the Scarlet camp; one of you can do it but both should click.

5098.obj: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it. Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
5098.note: Use the beacon at each of the four Andorhal towers.

5122.obj: Retrieve the Medallion of Faith from Malor the Zealous in the Scarlet Bastion and bring it back to Aurius.
5122.note: Malor's Strongbox in the Scarlet Bastion holds the medallion. Give it to Aurius in the chapel before fighting the Baron.

5125.obj: Give Aurius the Medallion of Faith; he joins the fight against Baron Rivendare. Claim his reward after the battle.
5125.note: Give Aurius the Medallion of Faith before the Baron fight; speak to him after Baron Rivendare dies.

5127.obj: Travel to Blackrock Spire, slay Goraluk Anvilcrack and use the Blood Stained Pike on his corpse. Also find the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate. Return the Soul Stained Pike and the breastplate to Lorax in Winterspring.
5127.note: Blacksmithing 270 (Armorsmith). Use the Blood Stained Pike on Goraluk's corpse and loot the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate nearby.

5153.obj: Bring Joseph's Wedding Ring to Chromie.

5154.obj: Bring the Annals of Darrowshire to Chromie in Andorhal.

5155.obj: Enter Jaedenar and slay 4 Jaedenar Hounds, 4 Jaedenar Guardsmen, 6 Jaedenar Adepts, and 6 Jaedenar Cultists before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5156.obj: Seek out and destroy 2 Entropic Beasts and 2 Entropic Horrors while exploring Shatter Scar Vale. After checking to see if the craters there are still filled with corrupt fel water, return to Taronn Redfeather in Felwood. -
req: Explore the craters in Shatter Scar Vale
5156.note: Entropic Beasts and Horrors are group mobs; fine for two careful players.

5157.obj: Take the Empty Canteen to the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar and fill it before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5160.obj: Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.
5160.note: Awbee is the wounded blue dragon near the arena route after Rend. Use the rune deep in the Mazthoril cave to reach Haleh.

5165.obj: Using the Purified Moon Well Water, douse the flames of the four braziers of protection within Shadow Hold in Felwood, then return to Greta Mosshoof in the Emerald Sanctuary.
5165.note: Four braziers in Jaedenar; each of you clicks them.

5168.obj: Bring Davil's Libram and Redpath's Shield to Carlin Redpath.

5181.obj: Bring the Skull of Horgus and the Shattered Sword of Marduk to Carlin Redpath at Light's Hope Chapel.

5203.obj: Escort Arko'narin to where Lightforge and her equipment are being held, and then protect her as you escape Shadow Hold. Afterwards, seek out Jessir Moonbow in Felwood to let her know what's happened to her friends.
req: Protect Arko'narin out of Shadow Hold

5204.obj: Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.

5211.obj: Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.
5211.note: Kill Cannibal Ghouls / Gibbering Ghouls / Diseased Flayers; a Darrowshire Spirit appears and you talk to it. Each of you frees your own.

5212.obj: Recover 20 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.
5212.pu: Betina Bigglezink, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
5212.ti: Betina Bigglezink, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
5212.note: Any undead in Stratholme can drop Plagued Flesh Samples.

5213.obj: Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.
5213.pu: Betina Bigglezink, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
5213.ti: Betina Bigglezink, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands

5214.obj: Find Fras Siabi's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Siabi's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.
5214.pu: Smokey LaRue, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
5214.ti: Smokey LaRue, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
5214.note: Newer Classic records call him Ezra Grimm. Clear the smoke shop, touch the tobacco box and kill the shopkeeper.

5243.obj: Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.
5243.pu: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
5243.ti: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
5243.note: Collect 5 Stratholme Holy Water from the supply crates in the streets; some crates spawn enemies.

g.n: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered — Eastern Plaguelands

5251.obj: Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.

5262.obj: Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the Eastern Plaguelands.
5262.ti: Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
5262.note: Hand in The Archivist first, or Balnazzar's head will not start this quest.

5263.obj: Venture to Stratholme and destroy Baron Rivendare. Take his head and return to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.
5263.pu: Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
5263.ti: Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
5263.note: Then Lord Maxwell Tyrosus and The Argent Hold, in Light's Hope Chapel, give the weapon or shield reward.

5282.obj: Use Egan's Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of Stratholme. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs! Free 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.

5341.obj: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.
5341.pu: Alexi Barov, The Bulwark, Tirisfal Glades
5341.ti: Alexi Barov, The Bulwark, Tirisfal Glades
5341.note: The four deeds: Southshore in the first large chamber, Tarren Mill before the hatchlings, Brill by Ras Frostwhisper, Caer Darrow by Lord Alexei Barov. The follow-up The Last Barov sends you to kill the rival brother.

5382.obj: Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.

5384.obj: Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul. Fight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sarkhoff.

5461.obj: Travel to the Arathi Highlands, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.

5463.obj: Travel to Stratholme and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.
5463.pu: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
5463.note: After Baron Rivendare dies, use the glowing rune on the floor of his room, then take the follow-up back to Leonid.

g.n: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered — Eastern Plaguelands

5466.obj: Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrate Marduke.
5466.pu: Magistrate Marduke, Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands
5466.ti: Magistrate Marduke, Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands
5466.note: Use the Soulbound Keepsake on Ras Frostwhisper to make him human, then kill him and bring back his human head.

5515.obj: Locate Jandice Barov in the Scholomance and destroy her. From her corpse recover Krastinov's Bag of Horrors. Return the bag to Eva Sarkhoff.

5518.obj: Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads, and Ogre Tannin to Knot Thimblejack. He is currently chained inside the Gordok wing of Dire Maul.
5518.note: Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads and 1 Ogre Tannin (basket on the upper level beyond Knot). Make any suits and learn the pattern before freeing Knot, because he leaves.

5525.obj: Find a Gordok Shackle Key on the ogres of the Gordok wing and use it to free Knot Thimblejack.
5525.note: Get a Gordok Shackle Key from the North ogres and free Knot; his cache has loot.

5526.obj: Find the Felvine in Dire Maul and acquire a shard from it. Chances are you'll only be able to procure one with the demise of Alzzin the Wildshaper. Use the Reliquary of Purity to securely seal the shard inside, and return it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.
5526.note: Kill Alzzin the Wildshaper, pick up a Felvine Shard near the vine and seal it in the Reliquary of Purity.

5529.obj: Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings, then return to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel.
5529.pu: Betina Bigglezink, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
5529.ti: Betina Bigglezink, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
5529.note: Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings. After turning this in, hatchlings can drop Healthy Dragon Scales, which start a repeatable turn-in to Betina.

5535.obj: Destroy 6 Highborne Apparitions and 6 Highborne Lichlings before returning to Loh'atu in Azshara.

5536.obj: Kill 6 Haldarr Satyr, 2 Haldarr Tricksters, 2 Haldarr Felsworn and then return to Loh'atu on the border of Ashenvale.

5542.obj: Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds. Return to Tirion Fordring when the task is complete.

5543.obj: Slay 30 Plaguebats and return to Tirion Fordring.

5544.obj: Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region. Slay them and harvest their meat. Return to Tirion Fordring when you have gathered 15 Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat.

5721.obj: Place the Relic Bundle at the Darrowshire town square. Prevent Davil Lightfire's death until the death of Horgus. Prevent Captain Redpath's death until Redpath the Corrupted appears. Defeat Redpath the Corrupted. Speak with the spirit of Joseph Redpath when he appears at the town square, then speak with Pamela at her home.

5742.obj: Listen to what Tirion Fordring has to say.

5781.obj: Travel to the Undercroft - at the southernmost section of the Eastern Plaguelands - and recover Taelan's Hammer. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.

5804.obj: Destroy Araj the Summoner and bring Araj's Scarab to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5845.obj: Travel to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the Eastern Plaguelands, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.

5848.obj: Travel to Stratholme, in the northern part of the Plaguelands. It is in the Scarlet Bastion that you will find the painting 'Of Love and Family,' hidden behind another painting depicting the twin moons of our world. Return the painting to Tirion Fordring.
5848.pu: Artist Renfray, Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands
5848.note: Take the painting hidden behind the twin-moons picture in Archivist Galford's room before you burn the archives.

5863.obj: Andi Lynn in Gadgetzan wants you to destroy the Dunemaul Compound by killing 10 Dunemaul Brutes, 10 Dunemaul Enforcers, and Gor'marok the Ravager.
5863.note: Gor'marok is in the middle cave of the compound; brutes and enforcers hit hard, pull one at a time.

5944.obj: Escort Taelan Fordring out of Hearthglen.

6004.obj: Kill 2 Scarlet Medics, 2 Scarlet Hunters, 2 Scarlet Magi and 2 Scarlet Knights before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

6023.obj: Kill Huntsman Radley and Cavalier Durgen before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

6025.obj: Enter Hearthglen and find a high vantage point from which you can see the town and gauge the Scarlet Crusade's forces, then return to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands. -
req: Overlook Hearthglen from a high vantage point

6041.n: When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent
6041.obj: Travel to Plaguewood, northwest of Light's Hope. Destroy 8 Scourge Structures by using Smokey's Special Compound at the Mark of Detonation planted inside each building. Smokey has had the Ziggurats and Slaughterhouses marked. Once you plant the bomb, leave the building and marvel at your handiwork. By the way, Smokey's Special Compound is rather... unstable.

6042.obj: Slay 20 Noxious Plaguebats and 10 Monstrous Plaguebats. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when you are finished.

6131.obj: Grazle wants you to prove yourself by killing 5 Deadwood Warriors, 5 Deadwood Pathfinders, and 5 Deadwood Gardeners.

6133.obj: Travel to the northern borders of the Eastern Plaguelands and recover the Quel'Thalas Registry. The item is somewhere in the Quel'Lithien lodge. You must also slay 8 Rangers, 8 Pathstriders, and 8 Woodsmen.
6133.note: Also needs the Quel'Thalas Registry from the table at the north-west camp.

6135.n: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...
6135.obj: Find Duskwing and slay him. From the corpse, recover a Patch of Duskwing's Fur and return it to Nathanos Blightcaller. It is said that Duskwing roams the countryside to the north of Marris Stead.

6136.obj: Find Borelgore in the northern wastes of Eastern Plaguelands and destroy him. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when the mission is complete.

6148.obj: The Scarlet Crusade is on the move. Somewhere along the road from Tyr's Hand to Stratholme you will find the Oracle, Demetria, and her entourage. Hunt her down and slay her. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller should you succeed.

6163.obj: Travel to Stratholme and slay Ramstein the Gorger. Take his head as a souvenir for Nathanos.
6163.pu: Nathanos Blightcaller, Marris Stead, Eastern Plaguelands
6163.ti: Nathanos Blightcaller, Marris Stead, Eastern Plaguelands

pre.n: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...

6164.obj: Bring Augustus' Receipt Book to Augustus the Touched in Terrordale.
6164.note: The book is upstairs in the Terrordale inn.

6521.obj: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras in the Undercity.

6569.obj: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes. Return to Myranda the Hag when the task is complete.

dg.n: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion

6602.n: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
6602.obj: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay General Drakkisath. Gather his blood and return it to Rexxar.

6626.obj: Kill 8 Razorfen Battleguard, 8 Razorfen Thornweavers, and 8 Death's Head Cultists and return to Myriam Moonsinger near the entrance to Razorfen Downs.
6626.pu: Myriam Moonsinger, Razorfen Downs thorn maze, The Barrens
6626.ti: Myriam Moonsinger, Razorfen Downs thorn maze, The Barrens
6626.note: These mobs are outside the instance, around the entrance.

7028.obj: Collect 25 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.
7028.note: Any Maraudon creature can drop the Theradric Crystal Carvings.

7029.obj: Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon. Use the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge. Heal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Vark Battlescar in Shadowprey Village.
7029.note: Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in the outer caves, then use it on Vylestem Vines inside (orange side) and kill the Noxxious Scions to heal 8 plants.

7044.obj: Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond. Find a way to speak with Celebras.
7044.note: The Celebrian Rod drops from Noxxion and the Celebrian Diamond from Lord Vyletongue.

7046.obj: Assist Celebras the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of Celebras. Speak with him when the ritual is complete.

7064.obj: Slay Princess Theradras and return to Selendra near Shadowprey Village in Desolace.
7064.note: Kill Princess Theradras in the inner cavern.

7066.note: Zaetar's Spirit appears after Princess Theradras dies.

7068.obj: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Uthel'nay in Orgrimmar.
7068.note: Shadowshard elementals in the outer purple-crystal caves. It can be done without entering the instance.

7201.obj: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 10 Essence of the Elements. Your first inclination is to search the golems and golem makers. You remember Vivian Lagrave also muttering something about elementals.
7201.note: Essence of the Elements drops from BRD elementals and golems.

Return to the Shen'dralar Ancient in the courtyard should you complete this quest.
7461.note: Kill the guardians of all five pylons, then Immol'thar, then Prince Tortheldrin. Return to the Ancient, take The Treasure of the Shen'dralar and open the chest under the library stairs for the reward.

7481.obj: Search Dire Maul for Kariel Winthalus. Report back to Sage Korolusk at Camp Mojache with whatever information that you may find.
7481.note: Interact with the Skeletal Remains of Telmius Dreamseeker beside Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum. Unlocks Lydros's libram exchanges.

7483.obj: Bring a Libram of Rapidity, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 2 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Blood of Heroes to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Rapidity.

7484.obj: Bring a Libram of Focus, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 4 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Skin of Shadow to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Focus.
7484.note: Repeatable. Needs your faction's Elven Legends turned in first.

7485.obj: Bring a Libram of Protection, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 2 Large Brilliant Shards, and 1 Frayed Abomination Stitching to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Protection.
7485.note: Repeatable. Needs your faction's Elven Legends turned in first.

7489.obj: Bring Lethtendris's Web to Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.
7489.note:
The web drops from Lethtendris.

7850.obj: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover 10 Vessels of Tainted Blood from Jintha'alor. Return to Primal Torntusk when this task is complete.

8320.obj: Kill 10 Twilight Geolords, then return to Huum Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.

Warrior class quest for both factions. Needs 2 amber, 2 blue and 2 green Voodoo Feathers from the six troll guardians: Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'Lor and Loro.

91607.obj: Find someone to appraise the Humongous Crystal.
